mapper.select: SELECT M.BIG_ROLL_CODE, GROUP_CONCAT(M.MACHINE_ID ORDER BY M.MACHINE_ID SEPARATOR ',') MACHINE_ID FROM T_GDYY_MACHINE_ROLL_MAPPING M LEFT JOIN T_GDYY_MACHINE_INFO MI ON MI.ID = M.MACHINE_ID WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND MI.STATUS = '0' GROUP BY M.BIG_ROLL_CODE
select ID, MACHINE_CODE, MACHINE_NAME, QUATA, CLASS_SHIFT, OPEN_MACHINE_CLASS, STATUS, REMARK from T_GDYY_MACHINE_INFO where STATUS = '0' and DEL_FLAG = '0'
